01 / About

Introduction — Who I Am

Portrait

3D Portrait Interactable
Draggable

I am a new media art designer, passionate about building bridges between code and the senses. I believe technology should not merely be a tool but a new artistic language for expressing emotions and conveying ideas.

The essence of design is communication — when pixels on a screen strike a chord with the viewer, when a code-generated pattern makes people pause and reflect, new media art fulfills its core mission: allowing technology to find warmth in humanity.
